info.description: The Customer Management API facilitates the creation and management of customer profiles within the system. This endpoint allows businesses to register new customers by their unique identifiers, enabling streamlined onboarding and customer interactions. Typical consumers of this API include developers working on e-commerce platforms, CRM systems, and any application that requires customer data integration. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance customer engagement and maintain accurate customer records seamlessly.

post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new customer record in the system. You need to provide the required details for the customer, and upon successful creation, you will receive a confirmation and the newly created customer's information.
